scope: Offline manual source-role reconciliation of 13 selected physical pages across five cached PDFs (47 total pages); not a complete candidate extraction or full-document amendment diff.

render_method.arguments: -scale-to 1500 -png; first 3 physical pages per multipage PDF, complete independent PDF
render_method.hash_semantics: Original source SHA hashes complete cached PDF body; render SHA hashes derived PNG bytes, not PDF page bytes. No per-page wire-byte claim.

Rotated candidate table; one United States Senator row; same legible ballot-name string as party amendment physical page 2. Other federal/state offices present; no full roster transcribed.
State Republican general-election certificate; signed/date August 26, 2026.

Continuation of judicial/state offices; no U.S. Senate heading on this page; no exhaustive-document absence inference.

Complete one-page signed state independent certificate dated August 26 for November 3. Six entries: State Senate districts 10 and 21; State House district 7 twice, 35, 65. No U.S. Senate heading on this page. No inference about all independent candidates or later editions.
Party amendment dated/received August 24; same amendment date, July 1 antecedent, August 11/withdrawal scope and corrective-action reservation as state package page 2.
Rotated table with one United States Senator row; manually observed ballot-name string agrees with state package page 3; party context comes from letter, not a party column.
Rotated State Senator and State Representative continuation; no U.S. Senate heading on this page; no document-wide absence inference.
Party chair letter dated August 28. Describes an omitted State House District 51 candidate and delivery of corrected certified list. Does not identify a U.S. Senate amendment.

Party nomination certification dated August 28; explicitly names November 3 general ballot. One U.S. Senate row; manually observed ballot-name string agrees with state package page 2. Heading refers to primary winners, but general-ballot role is explicit.
Judicial/state-office continuation; no U.S. Senate heading on this page; not an exhaustive amendment comparison.

bounded_reconciliation.party_labels: Democratic and Republican from certificate/letter context; no inference of a party cell on Democratic table.
bounded_reconciliation.independent_scope: Only the six state-legislative entries on the complete cached one-page certificate; no statewide/latest absence certificate.
bounded_reconciliation.republican_amendment_scope: August 28 cover identifies State House District 51 correction. Reviewed U.S. Senate entry unchanged; no claim other amendments absent.
bounded_reconciliation.date_conflict_resolution: State certification August 26 differs from embedded party letter dates; separate Republican August 28 amendment postdates state cover and is not itself a signed state certificate. Retrieval/HTTP dates do not prove pre-cutoff immutability.

reproduction_commands: .venv/bin/python /tmp/e01_al_role_evidence_v1.py (local preparation script, not a distributable pipeline)

For independent reproduction: verify each PDF SHA256 against original HTTP receipt; use pypdf to check page counts/text lengths; render physical pages 1-3 (or sole page) with pdftoppm -f 1 -l 3 -scale-to 1500 -png INPUT PREFIX; manually inspect the exact page roles and compare U.S. Senate entries locally. Pixel hashes may vary by renderer/runtime; original PDF hashes are authoritative.
